chapter.verse: Tu-in milim thoihna an tawh kisai-in “i vekpi-in thutheihna nei” i hihlam i thei hi. Hih thutheihna in hong kisialsak a, itna in ahihleh hong kipsak hi.
Mi khatpeuh in thu khatpeuh thei a kisak leh theih ding kilawmzah a thei lo ahi hi.
Ahi zongin mi khatpeuh in Pasian a it leh Pasian in zong amah thei pah hi.
Tua hi a, milim thoihna an nekna tawh kisai-in “leitung ah milim a taktak om lo” cih thu leh “Pasian khat bek om” cih thu i thei hi.
A hang pen vantung leh leitung ah pasian a kicite a omkha phial zongin—zong, pasian tampi leh topa tampi om takpi mah ahih hangin—

eite' ading ahihleh Pa ahi Pasian khat bek leh Jesu Khris ahi Topa khat bek om hi. Na khempeuh Pasian' kiangpan hi a, eite ama' adinga a om i hi hi. Na khempeuh Jesu Khris' hangin a piang hi a, eite zong ama' hanga piang i hi hi.

Ahi zongin mi khempeuh in hih thutheihna nei kim lo uh hi. Kimkhat pen milim biakna tawh kisawhkha khin ahihna uh tawh tu dong mah milim thoihna an takpi bangin ne uh a, kitheihtawmna lungsim thanem uh ahih manin a thanghuai suak uh hi.
Annek tuidawn in Pasian' maipha hong musak lo a, nek loh manin kisiazaw tuanlo, nek manin zong kihoihzaw tuanlo hi.
Ahi zongin hih na hamphatna thu uh thanemte' ading palkhaktheih a suah loh nading kidawm un.

A hang pen no thutheihna a neite milim biakna inn sungah an na nek uh mi khatpeuh in hong mu henla amah pen kitheihtawmna lungsim a thanem khat nahi hileh milim thoihna ante nek ding a thapia suak ding hilo na hi uh hiam?
Tua hangin hih a thanem mi, Khris in sihna tawh a tatkhiat sanggampa, pen note' thutheihna hangin a kisia ahi hi.
Tua hi a, na sanggamte uh tungah khialkha-in amaute a kitheihtawmna lungsim uh a thanem laitak na liamsak uhleh Khris' tungah a khial na hi uh hi.
Tua ahih manin anletui in ka sanggampa puksak ahihleh ka sanggampa a puksak ka hihloh nadingin sa ka ne ngei nawnkei ding hi.
